authorization.quote: Arc plan + adaptation decisions must be inputs before the per-episode layers are built, review revisions must be reflected in the final sealed narrative and downstream contract (sha binding). Reuse existing ledgers/knowledge/previs. Wire behind a policy profile/flag so already-sealed episodes (E01-E13, LEGACY) are unaffected and E14+ use it.

LEGACY.applies_to: every episode sealed before this capability existed
LEGACY.behaviour: byte-identical to before; nothing new is required, nothing new is checked
LEGACY.note: the sealed list is a record, not a gate: an episode named here is never re-judged

WRITER_CAPABILITY_V1.behaviour: arc ledger, adaptation dispositions, script review and the Rule 8 response are required inputs to S1; the sealed narrative must carry the sha the review was given

blocking.note: Nothing here stops a stage until the line owner turns it on.  The defaults record, they do not refuse.

sealed_binding.rule: the narrative the review read must be the narrative that is sealed; the receipt carries the narrative sha256 the review was bound to, and S1 compares
